"""Check public failure/adoption evidence and the completed continued control endpoint."""
import json
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1'
index=repo/'docs/results/v163-review-continuation-v2.json';data=read(index)
assert len(data['copies'])==17 and data['source_texts']==18
for item in data['copies'].values():
    assert ref(item['original']['path'])==item['original'] and ref(item['public']['path'])==item['public']
    assert Path(item['original']['path']).read_bytes()==Path(item['public']['path']).read_bytes()
bundle=read(data['source_bundle']['path']);assert ref(data['source_bundle']['path'])==data['source_bundle']
for item in bundle['source_texts']+[bundle['publisher']]:
    assert ref(item['path'])['sha256']==item['sha256'] and Path(item['path']).read_text()==item['text']
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan);guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v1.json'));guard(read(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json'))
neural={p:h for p,h in plan['frozen_files'].items() if Path(p).parent.name=='demosaic'};assert len(neural)==89
for p,h in neural.items():assert ref(repo/'src/demosaic'/Path(p).name)['sha256']==h
adoption=read(root/'review-adoption-v2.json')
collection=read(root/'review-v2/anchor-control-raw-step1000/collection-v1.json')
assert collection['component_forwards']==822 and collection['new_component_forwards']==554 and collection['adopted_prior_returned_forwards']==268
assert collection['module_before']==collection['module_after'] and collection['RNG_unchanged']
for key in ['forward_journal','observation_journal']:
    assert Path(collection[key]['path']).read_bytes().startswith(Path(adoption['original_'+key]['path']).read_bytes())
events=[json.loads(s) for s in Path(collection['forward_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]
assert [s['returned_forwards'] for s in events]==list(range(1,823))
assert [json.loads(s) for s in Path(collection['observation_journal']['path']).read_text().splitlines()]==collection['observations']
original=read(collection['original_control_collection']['path'])
for a,b in zip(collection['observations'],original['observations'],strict=True):
    assert a['id']==b['id'] and a['prediction']==b['prediction'] and a['archive_replayed_bit_exact']
    assert ref(a['prediction']['path'])==a['prediction']
docs=['README.md','docs/index.md','docs/current-model.md','docs/research.md','docs/experiments.md',
    'docs/harmonic-phase-inputs.md','diary/2026-11-07-07-13-12-v163-review-continuation.md']
links=0
for name in docs:
    path=repo/name
    for link in re.findall(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)',path.read_text()):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'):continue
        assert (path.parent/link.split('#')[0]).resolve().is_file(),(path,link);links+=1
output=repo/'docs/results/v163-review-continuation-verification-v2.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'pass-public-failure-evidence-source-bindings-and-complete-continued-control-endpoint',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'publication':ref(index),'byte_exact_receipts':17,'source_texts':18,
    'unchanged_neural_source_hashes_since_launch':89,'verified_adopted_calls':268,'verified_new_first_endpoint_calls':554,
    'first_complete_control_endpoint_calls':822,'first_complete_control_endpoint':ref(root/'review-v2/anchor-control-raw-step1000/collection-v1.json'),
    'strict_final_CPU_endpoint_loads':4,'finite_final_Adam_states':93,'exact_V162_training_rows':1000,
    'exact_inherited_training_masks':1000,'scientific_stage_failures':1,'full_training_restarts':0,'repeated_review_calls':0,
    'document_links_checked':links,'documents':{p:ref(repo/p) for p in docs},'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
    'verifier':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Historical live continuation plus first complete822-call control endpoint verified. Full candidate quality/phase removal/independent metrics/native viewing remain pending.'})
print('PASS17 receipts/18 source texts/89 unchanged neural modules;268 adopted+554 new=822 exact control calls;',links,'links')
